title: Delete scripts with no caller and fix the dangling workflow link
body:
Outcome: scripts/ci-stage-time.mjs and scripts/idle-gap-cache.mjs, their tests and test/fixtures/ci-stage-capture.json (1,859 lines) are gone; docs/program/repository-workflow.md names no missing docs/research/workflow-lessons.md.
Why: the operator wants KRN to hold no junk (memory:krn-only-scope); .krn/runs/roadmap-refill/junk-inventory.md found these with no importer outside their own tests and one dangling path. evals/fr40/results stays: evals/fr40/results.md reproduces the FR-40 verdict from it.
Proof: npm run fast PASS; git grep finds no reference to the deleted files.
Scope: this repository.
